The socks feature horizontal stripes in alternating bands of dark charcoal grey and warm orange/brown. The knit texture is prominent, showing a garter or stockinette stitch pattern. The toes are rounded and fully covered. The background consists of light-colored wooden planks with visible grain and gaps, suggesting a deck or floor.
